title: Reuse equivalent CI adapter build timing for a skipped landing

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-288#reuse-adapter-equivalent-timing

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-288#reuse-adapter-equivalent-timing (`.planning/seeds/SEED-288-landed-ci-evidence-follow-ups.md#reuse-adapter-equivalent-timing`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/565-reuse-adapter-equivalent-timing/PLAN.md`, revision `eb2bfebef561a1feab59a2d35cdf5ff1814247e7`. Isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-288-reuse-adapter-equivalent-timing-scratch` (clean pre-probe state; execution checkout unused for edits).
- **Promise.** Key example 1: timed adapter skip becomes a measured reused-equivalent point. Planning-only landing S, whose equivalent attempt P passed with start/completion but publishes no CI proof summary, joins P’s history point as reused equivalent with P’s wall time and is not a `No CI proof summary` gap.
- **Fault.** In `dashboard/server/exactSkippedEquivalent.ts` (`exactSkippedEquivalentSlot`), removed the settled no-proof timed-pass wall-time reuse branch (`proof.reason === "none"` with valid `historyWallTimeMs`), so equivalent reuse again requires `proof.kind === "summary"`. Fixture and assertions stayed intact; only production resolution changed.
- **Fixture.** `dashboard/tests/intent/intent-ci-wall-time-history-adapter.spec.ts` case “a CI adapter's timed attempt is a point of CI wall time that a planning-only skip reuses without proof…”, with adapter `proof: { unavailable: "no summary retained for this attempt" }` and landings P (timed pass) / S (planning-only).
- **Intended assertion.** The `expect.poll(…).toMatchObject({ entries: [ { kind: "point", revision: p.revision, landings: [exact P, equivalent S] }, … ] })` at `intent-ci-wall-time-history-adapter.spec.ts:105–121`. UI wording for reused equivalent was not reached because this poll failed first on the same promise.
- **Runs.** Focused command: `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- tests/intent/intent-ci-wall-time-history-adapter.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line` (AC power; macOS sleep guard).
  - Baseline (pre-fault): `1 passed (15.9s)`; `/usr/bin/time -p` real **17.32 s**.
  - Fault: `1 failed` on the intended `toMatchObject` poll (Timeout 5000ms). Received entries kept P as a `point` with exact-only landings and showed S as `kind: "gap", reason: "no-proof"` naming equivalent P — wrong behavior on the intended reuse path. Real **12.94 s**.
  - Restored: file bytes and SHA-256 matched the recorded original; `git status --porcelain` empty and HEAD `eb2bfebef561a1feab59a2d35cdf5ff1814247e7` matched pre-probe; same focused command `1 passed (29.0s)`, real **29.96 s**, exit 0.
- **Finding.** **Caught.** Requiring a proof summary again for equivalent reuse breaks key example 1, and the maintained adapter wall-time history proof fails on the intended S-joins-P assertion.

## Costs

- **Test runtime.** Measured with `/usr/bin/time -p` real on the focused command: baseline 17.32 s; fault 12.94 s; restored 29.96 s. Playwright line reporter also reported baseline 15.9 s and restored 29.0 s; fault had no parenthetical runner duration beyond `1 failed`.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported human-effort measure was recorded for this invocation.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported agent-effort (token or similar) measure was recorded for this invocation.



- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 133274 ms (measured), from 1794275955515 to 1794276088789 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
